item.text:
Hardened reordered raid confirmation using bounded authoritative retired-stream metadata. Source offline alone can now preserve a valid earlier dispatched raid; dispatch still requires both channels live. Current lifecycle and mark policies remain enforced.

Added memory/Firestore regressions and updated documentation.

Validation: **145 tests: 141 pass, 4 sandbox socket skips, 0 failures**. Release inventory and diff checks pass.

Manual historical confirmation remains fail-closed. No commit, deployment, live calls, or secret reads.
